scenes.say: At the poker table there's a point where neither player wants to change a thing.
John Nash proved it exists in every game like this: an equilibrium.
You bet half the pot. The bettor should bluff {gto_bluff} of the time.
And the caller must call at least {mdf} of the time, or get bluffed off the pot.
Step off that point, and the other player has a way to punish you.
Equilibrium isn't winning big. It's having no holes left to exploit.
